scenarios.name: status-question
scenarios.note: A plain status question: relayed to the supervisor, answered aloud.

segments.say: What's going on with my agents?

scenarios.name: approval-yes
scenarios.note: A mock herdr block (codex approval prompt) is announced; a bare 'yes' authorises it by transcript.

scenarios.name: instruction-promise
scenarios.note: An instruction plus a promise to report back.

segments.say: Tell auth to run the tests, and let me know when it's done.

scenarios.name: follow-up
scenarios.note: A follow-up question that leans on the previous turn.

scenarios.name: stop-mid-reply
scenarios.note: A question, then 'stop' spoken while the reply plays (barge-in).

segments.say: Give me a full rundown of every agent and what each one is doing.

scenarios.name: stop-button
scenarios.note: A question, then the stop button (cancel) while the reply plays.

scenarios.name: room-noise-only
scenarios.note: 10 s of cafe noise at -45 dBFS and no speech: nothing may be heard.

scenarios.name: speech-snr-10db
scenarios.note: A question under a cafe noise bed 10 dB below the speech.

segments.say: How is the docs agent doing?

scenarios.name: long-silence
scenarios.note: Nothing said for longer than voice.openai.idle_close_s: GPT-Live must close its session (billing stops).

scenarios.name: approval-yes-then-what
scenarios.note: Multi-turn (headset script step 3): the block is announced once, a bare 'Yes.' approves it within 3 s of speech, and 'What did I just approve?' is answered without sending keys. Added 2026-10-02 with the multi-turn, max_*_ms and absent assertions; not yet run live.
